events.summary: Speaker A set the product goals: the remote should be original, trendy and user-friendly.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: it should be original, it should be trendy and user-friendly

events.summary: Speaker A said the remote will have a selling price of about 25 Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: will have a selling price of about twenty five Euros

events.summary: Speaker A said the profit target for the product is 50 million Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the profit we are looking for for this product is fifty million Euros

events.summary: Speaker A said production costs should not be more than 12.50 Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the production costs should not be more than uh twelve Euro fifty

events.summary: Speaker A decided to focus the product internationally.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we will focus this internationally

events.summary: Speaker C proposed one remote controlling many devices, such as DVD players, cell phones, and video and audio equipment.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: So one re uh one remote control for all your equipment

events.summary: Speaker C proposed thinking about Bluetooth instead of infrared, since infrared is old technology.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: But you should uh think about the things like uh Bluetooth

events.summary: Speaker B objected that all TVs have infrared and that it is cost-effective, so infrared should stay.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: But all the T_V_s are uh equipped with infrared

events.summary: Speaker B proposed equipping one remote with both infrared and Bluetooth.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: you should equip infrared and Bluetooth together in one remote

events.summary: Speaker C said the remote is not made for one vendor but for a broad public, so it must fit every device.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: so it should fit to every device

events.summary: Speaker B said the basic technical function is that pressing a button changes the TV's state.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: just by pressing the button you should change the state of the T_V_

events.summary: Speaker C proposed a small joystick-style stick to move between channels or tracks.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: this little stick uh which you can move forward, sidewords

events.summary: Speaker B objected that having to point the remote directly at the TV is disturbing.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: I think it's it's quite disturbing when you always have to point directly to the T_V_

events.summary: Speaker B proposed that infrared need not be pointed, so it should be restricted to that case.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: so in that case infrared should uh maybe uh be restriction to that

events.summary: Speaker B said users must be able to feel the buttons and see them in the dark.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: it should be visible al um in dark too

events.summary: Speaker C asked whether a small display on the remote showing functions would help users.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: would it be nice for a user to have display on this uh remote control

events.summary: Speaker B proposed white buttons with black digits, which are visible in the dark without lighting.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: you can just have white buttons with a black mark on it

events.summary: Speaker C objected that the cost limit means the product cannot be high-end, since the cost price is very low.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: there's a cost limitation too

events.summary: Speaker B said the button digits must not fade, so the paint must stay clear on soft buttons.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: The digits of uh the the painting on the buttons should not fade

events.summary: Speaker A proposed a device that is easily rechargeable or uses little power, so batteries do not need changing often.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the device should either be rechargeable very easily um or it should not consume too much um power

events.summary: Speaker A proposed lighting only the buttons that apply at the moment, to save power.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: only light the buttons that are um uh applicable at that moment

events.summary: Speaker B objected that Bluetooth may be a power problem.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: But then Bluetooth uh might be problem

events.summary: Speaker B said Bluetooth cannot be used all the time, twenty-four hours a day.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: But you can't you can't use Bluetooth all the time, twenty four hours a day

events.summary: Speaker D objected that infrared may be an issue, since many devices already use it.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: infrared might be an issue
